KEKW.description: El Risitas laughing, universally denotes laughter, amusement, or comical situations.

OMEGALUL.description: Extreme laughter variant of LUL, conveys intense amusement.

LUL.description: TotalBiscuit laughing face, standard Twitch laughter emote.

pepeLaugh.description: Pepe holding in laughter with 'he doesn't know' connotation.

LO.description: Popular fast laughter emote on 7TV/Twitch (Caedrel/League streams).

ICANT.description: I Can't Even / extreme laughter variant.

catJAM.description: Cat headbobbing to music, signifies positive vibes and enjoyment.

HYPERCLAP.description: Fast clapping, enthusiastic amusement or applause.

Clap.description: Applauding or cheering on a fun moment.

PogChamp.description: Classic celebration, shock, excitement, or impressive high-tier play.

Pog.description: Excitement or celebration of a great in-game play.

POGGERS.description: Pepe variant of PogChamp celebrating an exciting moment.

GIGACHAD.description: Used to praise admirable, dominant, or hyper-confident gameplay.

NODDERS.description: Nodding in strong agreement, approval, or affirmation.

5Head.description: Used to praise high-IQ, genius plays or intelligent strategy.

Copium.description: Denotes self-delusion, denial, or ironic rationalization of a loss/mistake.

Hopium.description: Blind optimism or ironic hope in a losing situation.

monkaS.description: Sweating Pepe, conveys anxiety, tension, or ironic suspense.

monkaW.description: Zoomed-in monkaS indicating intense or mock panic.

Aware.description: Sudden grim realization, ironic disillusionment, or despair.

Clueless.description: Pretending not to know about impending disaster; heavy irony marker.

Kappa.description: The quintessential Twitch sarcasm, trolling, and irony marker.

Kapp.description: Shorthand variant of Kappa calling out doubt, lies, or sarcasm.

FeelsWeirdMan.description: Awkwardness, cringe, or questionable chat behavior.

WeirdChamp.description: Disapproval of cringe, weird, or uncalled-for remarks.

Pepega.description: Used to mock foolish, brainless, or severely miscalculated plays.

BabyRage.description: Mocks childish tantrums, whining, or sore losers.

4Head.description: Used ironically to dismiss oversimplified advice ('just win 4Head').

3Head.description: Used to mock low-intelligence, foolish, or silly mistakes.

PepeHands.description: Crying Pepe, denotes sadness or grief (can be sincere or comical).

Sadge.description: Depressed Pepe, signifies mild sadness, pity, or disappointment.

Prayge.description: Praying hands, expressing hope or pleading for RNG.

NOPERS.description: Shaking head no, simple denial or rejection.

HUH.description: Confusion or shock at an unexpected comment.

playful/laughing.description: Multiplies raw score by 0.40 and clamps to Level 1/2 for playful/laughing intent.

celebratory.description: Multiplies raw score by 0.40 and clamps to Level 1/2 for celebratory praise.

hostile/mocking.description: Boosts score and enforces Level 4 escalation for mocking/ridiculing intent.

sarcasm-marker.description: Escalates ambiguous messages to Mesh 2 LLM.

unclassified.description: No adjustment applied to unverified emotes.
